caption:
You already answer every call, quote every job, and close every sale.

Adding one more system to watch sounds like more work. That's the real objection: bandwidth, not cost or trust.

Here's the test: a system worth having runs on its own. A missed call triggers a text back in seconds. No one logs in to make it happen.

Try it on your own pipeline for 14 days, no card. If it adds work instead of removing it, you'll know by day three.

DM TRIAL

#ServiceBusiness #SmallBusinessGrowth #CRMForContractors #LeadFollowUp #HomeServiceMarketing
rationale: Carousels still win saves/depth for B2B objection content, and the owner-bandwidth fear ('I don't have time to run another system') is a genuinely unclaimed objection distinct from every prior cost, impersonal, lock-in, complexity, spam, adoption, migration, accuracy, shelfware, and desperate-reply objection already shipped.
